newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar moved off lows, spot ends steady.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar moved off lows, spot ends steady.

text.p: LIFFE sugar futures edged higher during late Wednesday trading, with front month August closing steady, while forward contracts finished lower.
Traders said New York values edged up towards the close, which encouraged the London market to tick up to its highs.
August closed at an unchanged $319.10 a tonne. Total turnover was 5,532 lots, which was boosted by switches and AAs.
At the EU tender, a total of 69,000 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 41.846 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
